# Dollars MoCap Documentation

> Official documentation for Dollars MoCap, an AI-powered motion capture and facial capture software suite by SunnyView Technology. Includes setup guides, feature references, troubleshooting, and integration tutorials for Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, and iClone.

## Motion Capture Products

- [Dollars MONO](https://docs.dollarsmocap.com/category/dollars-mono): Markerless full-body motion capture from a single webcam or video file. Setup, enhanced mode, facial capture modules, export formats, and FAQ.
- [Dollars DEEP](https://docs.dollarsmocap.com/category/dollars-deep): Depth-camera motion capture using Azure Kinect or Orbbec Femto. Calibration, camera placement, capture modes.
- [Dollars VIVA](https://docs.dollarsmocap.com/category/dollars-viva): HTC Vive Tracker motion capture.
- [Dollars SAYA](https://docs.dollarsmocap.com/category/dollars-saya): iOS-based motion and facial capture.

## Facial Capture Products

- [Dollars EGAO](https://docs.dollarsmocap.com/category/dollars-egao): Free webcam-based facial capture with ARKit blendshapes.
- [Dollars NVIS](https://docs.dollarsmocap.com/category/dollars-nvis): NVIDIA AR SDK facial capture.
- [Dollars LINK](https://docs.dollarsmocap.com/category/dollars-link): iClone 8 facial animation bridge.

## Interaction Products

- [Dollars MOTS](https://docs.dollarsmocap.com/category/dollars-mots): Text-to-motion generation.
- [Dollars SOMA](https://docs.dollarsmocap.com/category/dollars-soma): Pose and gesture recognition.

## Integration Guides

- [Integration Overview](https://docs.dollarsmocap.com/category/integration): Integration guides for engines and DCC software.
- Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, iClone integration documentation.

## Related Sites

- [Main Site](https://www.dollarsmocap.com): Product overview, pricing, and downloads.
